intro: Bring your best effort, support your teammates and enjoy your football.
review_note: Plain-language summary of the club’s published player code, prepared for review. The full club policy below takes precedence.

behaviours.title: Respect everyone
behaviours.description: Treat teammates, opponents and officials fairly. There is no place for bullying, discrimination, threats or abuse.

behaviours.title: Listen and work together
behaviours.description: Co-operate with your coach and teammates. Ask questions respectfully and raise concerns through the right club channels.

behaviours.title: Play fair. Stay in control.
behaviours.description: Follow the rules and respect refereeing decisions. Let the team manager raise issues with officials. Walk away from arguments.

behaviours.title: Give your best for the team
behaviours.description: Work hard, encourage others and recognise good play on both sides. Be a good sport and shake hands after the match.

behaviours.title: Enjoy the game
behaviours.description: Play because you enjoy it. Help others enjoy it too. Winning is only one part of football.

behaviours.title: Represent the club well
behaviours.description: Your behaviour matters off the pitch too. Follow club rules, including its alcohol, drugs and anti-doping policies. Breaches are handled by the Executive Committee.

intro: Set the example and create a positive place for every player to learn.
review_note: Proposed coach expectations — awaiting club approval. These suggestions do not replace the club’s safeguarding procedures or existing policies.

behaviours.title: Lead with respect
behaviours.description: Model calm, fair behaviour towards players, officials and opponents. Challenge bullying, discrimination and abusive language.

behaviours.title: Put players’ wellbeing first
behaviours.description: Listen when a player is worried or uncomfortable. Take concerns seriously and follow the club’s safeguarding and reporting procedures.

behaviours.title: Coach with encouragement
behaviours.description: Give clear, constructive feedback. Praise effort and learning. Never shame a player for a mistake or a result.

behaviours.title: Make room for everyone
behaviours.description: Adapt activities to players’ ages, abilities and needs. Give everyone meaningful opportunities to participate and develop.

behaviours.title: Be prepared and communicate
behaviours.description: Plan safe, enjoyable sessions. Explain expectations clearly, start on time and keep parents or guardians informed through club-approved channels.

behaviours.title: Keep appropriate boundaries
behaviours.description: Follow club guidance on supervision, communication, photographs and social media. Refer concerns through the safeguarding process rather than investigating them yourself.
